seed_data_creation: Test assemblies created during backend tests were cleaned up automatically via pytest fixture teardown. One test assembly (IC-002) was created and deleted during frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 verified complete Assembly (İclas) module functionality: 1) CRUD operations work via /api/assemblies endpoints. 2) Auto-ID generation creates IC-XXX format codes (IC-001, IC-002, etc.) based on document count. 3) All array fields (agendas, discussion_topics, tasks, responsible_persons, decisions) work correctly. 4) Department filter works via query parameter. 5) Frontend has all data-testid attributes for testing. 6) Expanded row detail shows all array data. 7) Edit modal pre-fills all fields correctly. 8) Excel export button present (uses xlsx library). 9) Search filter works on ID, purpose, department, responsible persons.

assemblies_crud.details: Create, Read, Update, Delete all working. POST/PUT/DELETE /api/assemblies/{id}

auto_id_generation.details: IC-XXX format auto-generated based on document count. Increments correctly (IC-001, IC-002, etc.)

array_fields.details: All array fields work: agendas, discussion_topics, tasks, responsible_persons, decisions

excel_export.details: Excel export button present with data-testid='export-excel-btn'. Uses xlsx library.
